tool.name: NCBI EGAPx execute
tool.description: annotates eukaryotic genomes from a local cache
tool.command: ## Link any history/indexed inputs staged into the cache by prepare_input if [ -d '$input_cache.extra_files_path/galaxy_staged' ]; then ln -s '$input_cache.extra_files_path/galaxy_staged' galaxy_staged; fi && ## Activate Nextflow conda environment and EGAPx Python virtual environment source /galaxy/env.bash && python3 '$__tool_directory__/prepare_egapx_config.py' --base-yaml '$input_config' --extra-yaml-file '$extra_yaml_file' --output-yaml 'egapx.yaml' && python3 /galaxy/scripts/galaxy-resource-config.py && python3 /galaxy/egapx/ui/egapx.py #if str($developer.query_limit.query_limit_selector) == "false" --force #end if 'egapx.yaml' --executor galaxy --output 'egapx_out' --local-cache '$input_cache.extra_files_path' #if str($developer.collect_star_bams) == "true" && bash '$__tool_directory__/get-bams.bash' #end if

param.name: input_config
param.label: EGAPx configuration YAML file to pass to Nextflow
